card.name: Punctuation opening warning headings
card.fires_on: Bullets, colons and closing parentheses at the start of a new warning or risk item in the boxed warning and highlights section of a drug label, often right after section references like (5.1) or the word WARNING.

modes.label: Colon after WARNING
modes.description: The colon right after the word WARNING that introduces a boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING<<:>> RISK OF HEART FAILURE See full

modes.label: Bullet or bracket after section numbers
modes.description: A bullet or closing parenthesis after a list of section references, just before the next risk item.
modes.example: Advise patients of potential risk to a fetus and to use effective contraception. ( 5.6 , 8.1 , 8.3<< )>> 5.1 Severe Hypers

modes.label: Linking word in REMS or risk statement
modes.description: A small word such as of or can inside a sentence naming a risk or REMS program.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label's highlights move on to a new warning or risk item.
